user.title: Xiaomi account
user.description: Pick the region shown in the Xiaomi Home app (Profile → Settings → Region) and how you want to sign in.

password.title: Sign in with your Xiaomi account
password.description: Your password is only used to sign in once. Home Assistant keeps a session token, not the password.

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description:
Xiaomi wants to make sure you are not a robot. Type the characters in the image (case sensitive).

![Captcha](data:image/jpeg;base64,{captcha_image})

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.description: Xiaomi sent a verification code by {method}. Enter it below.

devices.title: Feeders
devices.description: Choose the feeders to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Xiaomi session expired and could not be renewed automatically. Sign in again to keep your feeders working.

progress.scan_qr:
Open the Xiaomi Home app, tap the scan icon on the Profile tab and scan this code. Then confirm the sign-in on your phone.

![QR](data:image/png;base64,{qr_image})

You can also open [this link]({login_url}) on the phone where the app is installed.

error.invalid_code: The verification code was not accepted.
error.invalid_captcha: The captcha was not correct, try again.
error.blocked: Xiaomi temporarily blocked sign-ins from this network. Wait a while or use the QR code.
error.login_failed: Xiaomi rejected the sign-in. Try the QR code instead.

abort.already_configured: This account and region are already set up.
abort.no_devices: No Smart Pet Food Feeder 2 was found in region {server}. Check the region in the Xiaomi Home app.
abort.invalid_auth: The Xiaomi session is not valid.
abort.qr_expired: The QR code expired before it was confirmed.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Xiaomi account.

init.title: Updates
init.description: Real-time updates need the official Xiaomi Home integration with the same feeder. Found for {linked} of {total} feeders.

data_description.status_interval: How often to read bowl weight, alerts and settings.
data_description.records_interval: How often to ask Xiaomi's cloud for the food eaten today and the feeding log.
data_description.official_push: When the official Xiaomi Home integration reports a meal or a dispense, refresh right away instead of waiting for the next check. Polling keeps working as a fallback.

options.qr: QR code with the Xiaomi Home app

auth_expired.message: The Xiaomi session expired. Sign in again from the integration page.

update_failed.message: Could not update from Xiaomi's cloud: {error}

command_failed.message: The feeder did not accept the command: {error}

food_stuck.message: Food is jammed. Clear the jam before dispensing again.

unknown_device.message: {device_id} is not a feeder of this integration.

entry_not_found.message: There is no feeding at {time} in the schedule.

schedule_too_many.message: The schedule can have at most {max} feedings.

schedule_invalid_portions.message: The feeding at {time} must have between {min} and {max} portions.

schedule_too_close.message: Feedings must be at least 5 minutes apart ({first} and {second}).

dispense.name: Dispense food
dispense.description: Dispense food now. One portion is about 10 g.

set_schedule.name: Set feeding schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the whole daily feeding schedule.

entries.name: Feedings
entries.description: List of feedings, each with time (HH:MM) and portions (1-15).

auto_feed.name: Automatic feeding
auto_feed.description: Also turn automatic feeding on or off.

add_schedule_entry.name: Add feeding
add_schedule_entry.description: Add a daily feeding to the schedule, or change the portions of an existing one.

time.name: Time
time.description: Time of day, device local time.

remove_schedule_entry.name: Remove feeding
remove_schedule_entry.description: Remove a daily feeding from the schedule.

time.name: Time
time.description: Time of the feeding to remove.

set_schedule_entry_today.name: Skip or restore a feeding today
set_schedule_entry_today.description: Disable or re-enable one feeding for today only, like the app does.

get_feeding_history.name: Get feeding history
get_feeding_history.description: Return meals and dispenses recorded by Xiaomi's cloud (up to 90 days).

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back, including today.

get_hourly_stats.name: Get hourly statistics
get_hourly_stats.description: Return grams eaten and portions dispensed per hour, as in the app's daily chart.

get_daily_stats.name: Get daily statistics
get_daily_stats.description: Return grams eaten and food left in the bowl per day for the week (Sunday to Saturday), as in the app's weekly chart.

date.name: Date
date.description: Any day of the week to query (default today).
